formulas.roe: PAT / average net worth (equity capital + reserves)
formulas.cash_conversion_3y: sum of cash from operations over 3 years / sum of PAT over 3 years
formulas.inventory_days: 365 x average inventory / cost of goods sold
formulas.payable_days: 365 x average trade payables / cost of goods sold
formulas.cycle_days: receivable days + inventory days - payable days

commitments.target: Plan to capex at about INR300 crores for OSAT and PCB respectively.
commitments.quote: Our current goal is to capex at about INR300 crores for OSAT and PCB, but as and when, as I said earlier, with the subsidies coming up, we'll be funding more, and as and when we have more customers, we have to do more.
commitments.speaker: N. Muthukumar

claims.claim: Total revenue stood at INR946 crores, reflecting 40% year-on-year growth driven largely by EMS.
claims.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR946 crores, reflecting an year-on-year growth of 40%, which is largely driven by EMS business.

claims.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR147.6 crores with an EBITDA margin of 15.6%.
claims.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR147.6 crores, translating into an EBITDA margin of 15.6% and 31% year-on-year growth.

claims.claim: The company has a robust order book of around INR9,000 crores.
claims.quote: We have a robust order book of around INR9,000 crores.

claims.claim: Standalone EMS business grew 53% from INR480 crores to INR639 crores.
claims.quote: As a stand-alone EMS business if you see, our growth is 53%, from INR480 crores of last year to this year of INR639 crores stand-alone EMS business.

claims.claim: Metering business sales was INR204 crores compared to INR231 crores last year, a minus 12% growth.
claims.quote: At the metering business, last year first quarter our sales was INR231 crores, and this year it is INR204 crores, which means a minus 12% growth.

claims.claim: Received government subsidy to the tune of INR170 crores in OSAT business till July 26.
claims.quote: We also received, happy to say that we also received the government subsidy to the tune of INR170 crores in OSAT business till July 26.

analyst_concerns.question: Pushed back on softer EBITDA margins despite strong inventory and working capital increases.
analyst_concerns.quote: And while operating performance has been pretty strong given the increase in inventories as well as working capital, EBITDA margins have been much softer.

analyst_concerns.question: Asked about management's thought process on divesting the underperforming smart metering business.
analyst_concerns.quote: Any views in terms of opportunities to divest this business in future? Some of the utilities are looking to buy out the metering businesses, so what would be your thought process on this side to release both the working capital and management bandwidth from the smart metering direct B2C portfolio that we have here?

analyst_concerns.question: Questioned whether component shortages and price hikes would lead to gross margin compression over the next 9 months.
analyst_concerns.quote: So, do you expect in the coming 9 months we will see the gross margin compression because of that?

commitments.target: rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25%
commitments.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.
commitments.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

claims.claim: Total revenue stood at INR3,626.4 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 33.2%.
claims.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR3,626.4 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 33.2%.

claims.claim: EBITDA for FY 26 was INR5,741 million, registering 39.8% growth and translating to 15.8% margin.
claims.quote: Our EBITDA for the period FY '26 was INR5,741 million, registering a growth of 39.8% over the same period last year. This translates into an EBITDA margin of 15.8% for FY '26

claims.claim: Profit after tax came in at INR3,639 million, representing a PAT margin of 10% for FY 26.
claims.quote: while profit after tax came in at INR3,639 million, representing a PAT margin of 10% for FY '26.

claims.claim: Core EMS working capital days reduced from 83 days in FY 24 to 53 days in FY 26.
claims.quote: On a like-to-like basis, we would like to bring it to your attention that the core EMS business has demonstrated a significant improvement in the efficiency as committed earlier with the working capital days reducing from 83 days in FY '24 to 53 days in FY '26.

claims.claim: Near-term top line performance was impacted by geopolitical disruption leading to deferments.
claims.quote: Near-term top line performance did not fully meet market expectations, primarily due to geopolitical disruption, especially the West Asia conflict, which led to last-minute customer deferment, supply chain delays and product timing shift.

claims.claim: One of the largest electric vehicle OEM manufacturers dropped revenue by about 90%.
claims.quote: And one of the largest electric vehicle OEM manufacturers has completely dropped by about 90% of the revenue, wherein we were the single supplier which has dropped our numbers.

analyst_concerns.question: Pressed on the vast variance between expected versus delivered numbers and guidance sanctity.
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, how should, as investors, we look at this guidance? And what is the sanctity of the guidance that we are providing, sir? Because there is a very vast variance between what was expected versus what is delivered, sir?

analyst_concerns.question: Raised concern over a large negative operational cash flow against prior guidance.
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, OCF INR600 crores of negative, I think that is a bigger disappointment, especially when you kind of guided that you will be just about neutral or slightly negative, sir.

analyst_concerns.question: Queried about the increase in receivables and lack of progress on securitization in the metering subsidiary.
analyst_concerns.quote: Because sir, I think this is exactly same from what was given in last quarter concall. So there is no progress in this quarter at all in this?

analyst_concerns.question: Asked about the key reasons for the increase in intangible assets from FY25 to FY26 balance sheet.
analyst_concerns.quote: In balance sheet, the intangible asset in FY '25 was INR238 crores. And in FY '26, it is INR536 crores. So what was the INR300 crores increase? What was the key reason for that?

commitments.target: Expect at the minimum 1,500 crores from the OSAT business.
commitments.quote: So, at the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business.
commitments.speaker: Jairam Sampath

commitments.target: Expect about 1,000 crores from the PC Board business.
commitments.quote: Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.
commitments.speaker: Jairam Sampath

commitments.target: Maintain net working capital between 70 to 85 days.
commitments.quote: So typically, what we expect is about between 70 to 85 days.
commitments.speaker: Jairam Sampath

commitments.target: Spend about another 400-odd crores of capex in this year.
commitments.quote: So you can take broadly in this year, maybe about another INR400-odd crores of capex will be spent.
commitments.speaker: Jairam Sampath

claims.claim: Total revenue stood at 23,837 million with 37 percent year-on-year growth.
claims.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR23,837 million, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 37%.

claims.claim: Operational EBITDA for the quarter was 3,778 million, registering 55 percent growth.
claims.quote: Operational EBITDA for the quarter was INR3,778 million, registering a growth of 55% over the same period last year.

claims.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 190 basis points year-on-year to 15.9 percent.
claims.quote: This translates into an EBITDA margin of 15.9%, an expansion of 190 basis points year-on-year.

claims.claim: Profit after tax came in at 2,726 million, representing an 11.4 percent PAT margin.
claims.quote: Profit after tax came in at INR2,726 million, representing a PAT margin of 11.4%.

claims.claim: The company has an order book of around 90,000 million pending.
claims.quote: We have an order book of around INR90,000 million, which is pending with us.

claims.claim: The FSA approval under the ISM framework for OSAT is now in place.
claims.quote: I am pleased to confirm that this approval is now in place.

analyst_concerns.question: How long does the current order book get executed and where are the delays?
analyst_concerns.quote: How long does the current order book get executed? And where have you seen some delays?

analyst_concerns.question: What is the reason for elevated working capital and how to bring net working capital down?
analyst_concerns.quote: So firstly, what is the reason for this? And secondly, we maintain our guidance of bringing down the net working capital to 85 days by March '26.

analyst_concerns.question: What were the metering revenues and how to reduce long-term debtors from Iskraemeco?
analyst_concerns.quote: First, can you help us understand what were the numbers of revenues coming in from the metering business?

analyst_concerns.question: What are the risks that could hurt the achievement of the 1 billion dollar revenue target?
analyst_concerns.quote: So, when you say the $1 billion revenue, what are the risks we are seeing which will hurt not to achieve those things?

unverified.target: Achieve 1 billion dollars in revenue by FY28.
unverified.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that

claims.claim: H1 FY25 loss driven by lower revenue, inventory write-offs, and corporate cleanup.
claims.quote: First is significantly lower revenue, which is about INR85 crores or INR851 million, while fixed costs have been remaining largely unchanged. Second thing is provision arising from Kaynes due diligence, including inventory write-offs. And third thing is broader corporate cleanup and other adjustments.

claims.claim: RPTs were eliminated in consolidated financials; the oversight was a notes omission in a subsidiary.
claims.quote: The related party transactions were appropriately eliminated and consolidated financial statements in accordance with Ind AS. The oversight pertains solely to the notes to the stand-alone financial statements in one of the companies, but the disclosure was inadvertently omitted.

claims.claim: Kaynes will exit full project implementation and operate strictly as a device manufacturer and software provider.
claims.quote: We are also planning to exit from day one. When we took over this company, we wanted only to become a device manufacturer. So, we will no longer be an AMISP company. We will be only device company to various AMISPs. And our software, we will also sell it to them as a service.

claims.claim: Samples have been shipped out to three semiconductor clients, technically starting commercial production.
claims.quote: And all three of them, one of them, we were the first in the country to actually ship out the chipsets, even though we got this thing the last, the approvals the last. And so, the samples have been shipped out, so in some sense, technically, the commercial production has started.

analyst_concerns.quote: Second thing to Jairam sir, will be on the receivable side. analyst_concerns.question: Clarification on organic growth rate in H1 and growth catalysts moving forward.
analyst_concerns.quote: Can you provide some clarifications on what's the proposed, what was said in the report about the organic growth rate in the first half? And then can you also kind of look forward and talk about how you plan on growing the business?

analyst_concerns.quote: Could you give us the breakup of consolidated PAT among subsidiaries for the second quarter and first half, sir?

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management claimed total FY26 revenue grew 33.2% year-on-year to ₹3,626.4 crore.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN reports FY26 revenue of ₹3,626 crore, representing 33.2% growth over FY25 revenue of ₹2,722 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management highlighted core EMS working capital reduction in FY26 earnings call.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN shows net working capital cycle days deteriorated from 92.88 days in FY25 to 135.05 days in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reported Q1 FY27 revenue reached ₹946 crore, reflecting 40% year-on-year growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN reports Jun 2026 revenue of ₹946 crore, reflecting 40.6% growth over Jun 2025 revenue of ₹673 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management noted negative operational cash flow concerns in Q4 FY26 earnings call.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN shows FY26 cash flow from operations was negative ₹600 crore compared to negative ₹82 crore in FY25.

bull.point: Revenue grew at a 3-year CAGR of 47.7% to ₹3,626 crore in FY26, supported by an order book of ₹8,366.3 crore.
Standalone EMS business grew 53% year-on-year from ₹480 crore to ₹639 crore in Q1 FY27.
Operating profit margins remained healthy at 15.9% in FY26 and 15.6% in Q1 FY27.

bear.point: Free cash flow deteriorated to negative ₹1,841 crore in FY26 with a 3-year cash conversion of -0.707.
Working capital cycle days rose to 135.05 days in FY26 from 92.88 days in FY25, worsening cash flow.
Customer A contributed 23.99% of total sale of goods in FY26, showing significant customer concentration.

watch.point: Capex deployment progress of ₹300 crore each for OSAT and PCB facilities in FY27.
Improvement in operational cash flow and reduction of working capital cycle days from 135.05 days.
Resolution or divestment strategy regarding the underperforming smart metering business segment.
